assertion_results.text: The plan determines feature-branch workflow mode (not direct-to-main) based on the atomicity constraints in the feature description
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states 'Selected mode: feature-branch' with rationale citing three atomicity indicators: 'Coordinated schema migrations', 'Tightly coupled feature components' (quoting the feature's NFR 'All changes must land together'), and 'Cross-cutting refactors'. These directly reference the atomicity constraints from the feature description.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type create-branch is generated as the first task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-1-create-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\ncreate-branch' and is task 1. summary-comment.md confirms: '1 | Create feature branch TC-9005 from main | trustify-backend | main | Bookend (create-branch)'.

assertion_results.text: A bookend task with Bookend Type merge-branch is generated as the last task in the plan
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-branch.md contains '## Bookend Type\nmerge-branch' and is task 8, the last task. summary-comment.md confirms: '8 | Merge feature branch TC-9005 to main | trustify-backend | main | Bookend (merge-branch)'.

assertion_results.text: All intermediate tasks (between the create-branch and merge-branch bookend tasks) have Target Branch set to TC-9005
assertion_results.evidence: All intermediate tasks (2-7) have '## Target Branch\nTC-9005': task-2-migration-advisory-status-enum.md, task-3-update-seaorm-entities.md, task-4-update-advisory-service-endpoints.md, task-5-update-ingestion-pipeline.md, task-6-update-integration-tests.md, task-7-documentation.md. Also confirmed in summary-comment.md table.

assertion_results.text: The create-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main
The merge-branch bookend task has Target Branch set to main

All non-documentation intermediate tasks list the create-branch bookend task as a dependency. Documentation tasks may list implementation tasks as dependencies instead of the create-branch bookend task, since documentation depends on implementation completion
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks all list Task 1: task-2 ('Depends on: Task 1 -- Create feature branch TC-9005 from main'), task-3 (same), task-4 (same), task-5 (same), task-6 (same). Documentation task-7 lists 'Depends on: Task 4' and 'Depends on: Task 5' instead, which is allowed per the assertion.

assertion_results.text: The merge-branch bookend task lists all non-documentation intermediate tasks as dependencies
assertion_results.evidence: task-8-merge-branch.md lists dependencies on Tasks 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 -- all five non-documentation intermediate tasks. Task 7 (documentation) is correctly excluded.

assertion_results.text: Each non-documentation task file contains all required template sections: Repository, Target Branch, Description, at least one of Files to Modify or Files to Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Documentation tasks are exempt from requiring Files to Modify, Files to Create, and Implementation Notes — they must still include Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, and Test Requirements
assertion_results.evidence: Non-documentation intermediate tasks 2-6 all contain: Repository, Target Branch, Description, Files to Modify/Create, Implementation Notes, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements. Task 7 (documentation) contains Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements (exempt from Files to Modify/Create and Implementation Notes). Bookend tasks (1, 8) have their own template structure with Bookend Type section and contain Repository, Target Branch, Description, Acceptance Criteria, Test Requirements.

assertion_results.text: The plan includes a workflow:feature-branch label decision to be applied to the feature issue
assertion_results.evidence: impact-map.md states: 'The `workflow:feature-branch` label will be applied to the TC-9005 feature issue.' summary-comment.md also states: 'Workflow mode: feature-branch'.

assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:'
assertion_results.evidence: Eight separate digest files exist (task-1-digest.md through task-8-digest.md), one for each task. Each contains '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-hex>' with valid 64-character lowercase hex hashes. Examples: task-1-digest.md has 'sha256-md:a236fd7db989f4f728be86758c32c119584d4ac71fbb0d678619475c43cf49fc', task-2-digest.md has 'sha256-md:983f5b7b07632148c258afaafcd38a822ceec6f6cb69253a877ccd536d5f1ed6'.

assertion_results.text: Convention-aware enrichment validates file-type applicability per shared/convention-applicability-rules.md before including a convention — inapplicable conventions are excluded entirely (not listed with 'Not applicable' annotations), and applicable ones include a rationale in the prescribed format ('Applies: task modifies <file> matching the convention's <scope>'), not free-form prose
assertion_results.evidence: All convention references use the prescribed format. Task 2: 'Per CONVENTIONS.md §Error Handling: use `.context()` wrapping...\nApplies: task creates `migration/src/m0002_advisory_status_enum/mod.rs` matching the convention's `.rs` file scope.' Task 3: 'Applies: task modifies `entity/src/advisory.rs` matching the convention's `.rs` file scope.' Task 4: two conventions both with 'Applies: task modifies <specific file> matching the convention's `.rs` file scope.' Tasks 5 and 6 follow the same pattern. No inapplicable conventions are listed with 'Not applicable' annotations.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a priority set (not 'Undefined'), the plan documents that the Feature's priority is inherited by created tasks — evidenced by priority field values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When the Feature's priority is 'Undefined', the plan documents that priority inheritance is skipped (not propagated as null or 'Undefined')
assertion_results.evidence: Feature priority is 'High'. impact-map.md documents: '"priority": {"name": "High"}' in Additional Fields and '**Priority**: "High" -- inherited from parent Feature TC-9005'. summary-comment.md states: '**Priority**: High -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks'.

assertion_results.text: When the Feature issue has a non-empty fixVersions array and the fixVersion scope config (from ### Jira Field Defaults in CLAUDE.md) is 'task' or 'both' (or absent, defaulting to 'both'), the plan documents that fixVersions are inherited by created tasks — evidenced by fixVersion values in the impact map, task creation log, or task description files. When fixVersion scope is 'feature' or the Feature has no fixVersions, the plan documents that fixVersion inheritance is skipped
assertion_results.evidence: Feature has fixVersions 'RHTPA 2.0.0' and CLAUDE.md scope is 'both'. impact-map.md documents: '"fixVersions": [{"name": "RHTPA 2.0.0"}]' and '**fixVersions**: "RHTPA 2.0.0" -- inherited from parent Feature TC-9005; `fixVersion scope` is "both" per Jira Field Defaults, so propagated to tasks'. summary-comment.md states: '**fixVersions**: RHTPA 2.0.0 -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks (fixVersion scope: "both")'.

assertion_results.text: A summary of inherited field propagation is produced — evidenced by a summary-comment.md file in the outputs directory, or a summary section in the impact map that includes the inherited priority and fixVersion values propagated to tasks, or states they were omitted and why
assertion_results.evidence: summary-comment.md exists and contains '## Inherited Field Values' section with '**Priority**: High -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks' and '**fixVersions**: RHTPA 2.0.0 -- propagated from Feature TC-9005 to all created tasks (fixVersion scope: "both")'. Additionally, impact-map.md contains an 'Additional Fields' section documenting the same propagation.
